title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 4x MI300A
summary: Dynamic optimization replay with overlapping hypothesis lifetimes, versioned measurements, and inspectable agent turns.
provenance: Optimization names and listed measurement values are transcribed from the campaign trajectory and notes. Workstream interval boundaries, role assignments, and conversational turn text are curated reconstructions, not recovered backend records. Numeric values are only included where present in the trajectory or supplied campaign notes.

objective.title: Improve serving goodput under the campaign latency and quality constraints
objective.statement: Improve Qwen3.5-397B-A17B serving goodput on one 4x MI300A ROCm node while respecting reference latency, output quality, and benchmark integrity.
constraints: Keep the benchmark version visible because v4 and v5 workloads are not directly comparable.
Workload: 3–6 turns, 1–8 seconds think time, up to 48 sessions, greedy decoding with ignore-EOS, exactly 80–300 generated tokens.
Accuracy: 13 probes plus pins; at least 90% exact on the first 32 tokens, and no divergence before token 8 for the remaining probes.
Benchmark integrity: no dropped, errored, empty, or wrong-length outputs.
Use one node with 4x MI300A GPUs on ROCm.
Do not import, copy, or install SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM engine code.

gates.label: Reference latency
gates.description: p95 TTFT stays within the version-specific reference threshold.

gates.label: Output quality
gates.description: Pass 13 probes plus pins: at least 90% exact on the first 32 tokens, with no divergence before token 8 on remaining probes.

gates.label: Benchmark integrity
gates.description: No dropped, errored, empty, or wrong-length outputs; generate exactly 80–300 tokens with greedy ignore-EOS decoding.

benchmarkVersions.label: Benchmark v4
benchmarkVersions.description: Earlier harness and workload definition. Its total token throughput and turn-2+ TTFT definitions are shown separately from v5.

benchmarkVersions.label: Benchmark v5
benchmarkVersions.description: Corrected harness and revised workload. Its peak goodput and reference TTFT are not directly comparable to v4 metrics.

benchmarkVersionBoundary.reason: The harness and workload definition changed. The rise around 790 to 1042 tok/s also spans C64 to C96 scaling, so the cross-boundary difference is not attributable to one optimization.

workstreams.title: Prefix cache
workstreams.hypothesis: Reuse matching prompt prefixes to reduce repeated prefill work.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Prefix-cache candidate accepted in the campaign trajectory.

workstreams.title: Decode graphs + MoE
workstreams.hypothesis: Capture decode graphs and optimize the MoE path to improve steady-state serving throughput.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Decode graphs + MoE kernel milestone accepted.

workstreams.title: Prefill graphs
workstreams.hypothesis: Graph capture on prefill reduces launch overhead for the evaluated request mix.

workstreams.title: One-shot all-reduce
workstreams.hypothesis: A one-shot collective lowers synchronization overhead in the serving path.

workstreams.title: Mixed-step graph
workstreams.hypothesis: A mixed-step graph can improve utilization across decode step shapes.

workstreams.title: MoE + GEMM
workstreams.hypothesis: MoE and GEMM tuning improves throughput without breaking the paired serving checks.

workstreams.title: Sequence-parallel AR
workstreams.hypothesis: Sequence-parallel autoregressive execution improves the long-sequence path.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Sequence-parallel AR milestone accepted in the campaign notes.

workstreams.title: Fold turn suffix
workstreams.hypothesis: Folding repeated turn-suffix work improves the paired late decode measurement.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Accepted paired v5 improvement: 1053.390534 to 1154.477039 tok/s.

workstreams.title: Snapshot reclaim
workstreams.hypothesis: Reclaiming snapshot state increases usable throughput on the late campaign stack.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Snapshot reclaim accepted; repeated late measurements were 1610.1 and 1621.2 tok/s.

workstreams.title: MoE BT32
workstreams.hypothesis: The BT32 MoE configuration improves throughput over its paired control.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: MoE BT32 and repeat measured 1327.0 and 1323.7 tok/s against the 1266.2 tok/s control.

workstreams.title: Prefill GEMM cache
workstreams.hypothesis: Caching the prefill GEMM improves the late prefill workload.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Prefill GEMM cache measured 1299.7 tok/s against its 1235.2 tok/s control.

workstreams.title: Early prefill launch
workstreams.hypothesis: Launching prefill earlier improves pipeline utilization on the late stack.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Early-launch measurements were 1351.0 and 1362.7 tok/s against a 1301.3 tok/s control.

workstreams.title: MTP speculative decoding
workstreams.hypothesis: Speculative decoding increases goodput while preserving the evaluated token sequence.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: The stable hypothesis includes two rejected wrong-token/suffix attempts at 958.6 and 973.0 tok/s, then the accepted candidate at 2242.4 tok/s and repeat at 2201.4 tok/s.

workstreams.title: Sequence-parallel AR late stack
workstreams.hypothesis: Integrate sequence-parallel AR with the late serving stack.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: Late sequence-parallel stack was accepted at 1889.9 tok/s before the MTP candidate.

workstreams.title: C112 concurrency expansion
workstreams.hypothesis: Increasing concurrency beyond C96 improves goodput within serving constraints.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: C112 candidates at 999.9226 and 998.8531 tok/s were rejected against the paired control.

workstreams.title: C96 corrected benchmark
workstreams.hypothesis: The corrected benchmark reports the C96 serving configuration under the v5 workload.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: C96 corrected benchmark recorded at 1042 tok/s. The change from the earlier v4 value also includes the workload correction.

workstreams.title: Chat-history diagnostic
workstreams.hypothesis: A chat-history change explains an apparent late throughput shift.
workstreams.outcomeSummary: The diagnostic measured 814.2 tok/s and was rejected against its paired incumbent.
